notes.Giannis Antetokounmpo: He played 41 minutes in Wednesday's overtime win at the Clippers, his most this season, with 27 points, 14 rebounds and six assists after 31 to 34 minutes in the three games before. notes.Bam Adebayo: He set season highs with 35 points and 10 rebounds in 41 minutes Wednesday in overtime at the Clippers. Miami is on the second night of a back-to-back and has not posted its injury report yet.
notes.Klay Thompson: His minutes have climbed as a starter, from 17 to 26, 27 and then 35 in Wednesday's overtime win, when he scored 30 with eight threes and hit the game-winner. It is his first game back at Golden State in a Heat uniform, but it is the second night of a back-to-back and Miami's injury report is not posted yet.
notes.Davion Mitchell: He played 43 minutes with 10 assists in Wednesday's overtime win and has 10 or more assists in three of his last four games. Miami's injury report for the back-to-back is not posted yet.
notes.Pelle Larsson: He has played 24 to 35 minutes off the bench in each of his last four games, including 35 Wednesday, though he scored only seven points that night. Miami has not posted its injury report yet.
notes.Andrew Wiggins: He has started every game but played only 24 and 23 minutes in his last two, with seven and three points. Miami has not posted its injury report yet.
notes.Bobby Portis: He has played 17 or 18 minutes off the bench in each of his last three games and had 10 rebounds and five assists Wednesday. Miami has not posted its injury report yet.
notes.Stephen Curry: He rested Sunday and came back Monday with 34 points, six rebounds and seven assists in 33 minutes, and he is not on Golden State's injury report tonight. notes.Yaxel Lendeborg: The rookie has started every game and played 24 to 35 minutes in his last four, with 37 points Sunday and 16 points, five rebounds and five assists Monday. Gui Santos is out again, which keeps the frontcourt minutes with him.
notes.Brandin Podziemski: He has started each of his last four games at 32 to 37 minutes, with 17 points, eight rebounds and eight assists Sunday and 20 points Monday. Jimmy Butler and Moses Moody remain out.
notes.Draymond Green: He played only 17 minutes Monday after 27 to 32 minutes in his three games before that. He is not on Golden State's injury report tonight.
notes.De'Anthony Melton: He started Sunday and scored 21 in 28 minutes, then played 28 minutes off the bench Monday. With Jimmy Butler, Moses Moody and Gui Santos out, the wing minutes stay open.
notes.Georges Niang: He has played 19 to 23 minutes in each of his last four games, with 13 points Monday. Kristaps Porzingis and Gui Santos are out, which keeps him in the frontcourt rotation.
notes.Al Horford: He sat Monday for rest on the second night of a back-to-back, not an injury, and is available tonight. He played 17 to 22 minutes in his four games before that, with nine points and five rebounds Sunday.
notes.Will Richard: He started Monday and played 28 minutes, his most in his last four games, though he scored six points. Gui Santos is out again tonight, so the starting spot may stay his.
notes.Brandon Williams: He missed Monday with a left quad bruise but is available tonight. He scored 17 in 25 minutes Sunday, his most minutes in his last four games.
notes.Franz Wagner: He has played 38 to 40 minutes in each of his last three games, with 24 points, three rebounds and six assists Monday. Paolo Banchero (ankle) and Jalen Suggs (knee) are both out again, which keeps the offense in his hands.
notes.Desmond Bane: He has played 34 to 40 minutes in each of his last four games and scored 19 and 20 in the last two. Paolo Banchero and Jalen Suggs are out again.
notes.Anthony Black: He sat Monday on the second night of a back-to-back and is not on Orlando's injury report tonight. In his two starts before that he had 17 points, six rebounds and 10 assists, then 23 points and eight rebounds, in 31 and 33 minutes.

notes.Tristan da Silva: He has played 23 to 35 minutes off the bench in each of his last four games, with 23 points and 10 rebounds Sunday. Paolo Banchero is out again.
notes.Jase Richardson: He has started Orlando's last three games at 26 to 33 minutes but has not scored more than nine. Jalen Suggs is out again, so the guard minutes remain there for him.
notes.Jamal Cain: He started Monday with Anthony Black resting and played 25 minutes with 10 points, after 15 to 18 minutes off the bench before that. Black is not on the injury report tonight, which points Cain back toward a bench role.
notes.Nikola Vucevic: He played 14 minutes Monday after only six and seven in the two games before. He is a backup center behind Wendell Carter Jr.
notes.Goga Bitadze: He has played only five and six minutes in his last two games, so his role is small.
notes.Devin Booker: He scored 33 points, going 13 for 13 at the line, in 34 minutes Wednesday against Portland, and he has played 34 to 39 minutes in each of his last four games. notes.Miles Bridges: He has played 31 to 37 minutes in each of his last four games and scored 40 or more DraftKings points in three of them, including 18 points, seven rebounds and five assists Wednesday. Phoenix has not posted its injury report yet.
notes.Jalen Green: He scored 22 in 32 minutes Wednesday after 11 points with eight rebounds and eight assists in 36 minutes Monday. Phoenix has not posted its injury report yet for the back-to-back.
notes.Dillon Brooks: He has played 33 to 35 minutes in three of his last four games, with 15 points and six rebounds Wednesday. Phoenix has not posted its injury report yet.

notes.Khaman Maluach: He keeps starting but has played only 13 to 17 minutes in each of his last three games, as Oso Ighodaro takes the bigger share of the center minutes.
notes.Collin Gillespie: He has played 23 and 24 minutes off the bench in his last two games but scored only three and two points. Jordan Goodwin is day-to-day with a calf injury, which could open more guard minutes if he sits.
notes.Luke Kennard: He has played 12 to 18 minutes off the bench in each of his last four games and went scoreless in 14 minutes Wednesday. Phoenix has not posted its injury report yet.
notes.Ryan Dunn: He played 18 minutes Wednesday, up from 10 to 14 in his previous three games, with six rebounds. Phoenix has not posted its injury report yet.
notes.Gary Payton: His minutes have grown from 10 and 8 to 15 and 20 in his last two games. He is not on Golden State's injury report.
